blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– The 2026-27 NBA Cup group stage continued Wednesday, November 25 (Thursday, November 26 US time), with some record-breaking numbers. LeBron James recorded his first triple-double as a 76er in Philadelphia’s win over Miami, while Kevin Durant reached 33,000 career points as Houston beat Phoenix. Philadelphia 76ers beat Miami Heat, 111-104 LeBron James recorded his first triple-double with Philadelphia, finishing with 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds.
